asmjit (vendored)
=================

Upstream : https://github.com/asmjit/asmjit
Commit   : 677a10bac2c24f7e068cf1f9e675bf51c7b534ea
Date     : 2026-11-04
Subject  : [abi] Added address range support to VirtMem and JitAllocator
License  : Zlib (see LICENSE.md)

Do not edit files in this directory. Local patches must be either
(a) upstreamed, or (b) recorded here with the patch file next to it.

What was copied
---------------
Every header and every non-test source file of the upstream `src/asmjit`
directory, keeping the original layout:

    asmjit.h  core.h  x86.h  arm.h  a64.h  ujit.h  host.h  build_defs.h
    core/  x86/  arm/  axl/  ujit/

Test translation units (`*_test.cpp`, 37 of them) were NOT copied: upstream
builds them only through its own CMake test targets.

What is compiled
----------------
The set of .cpp files handed to the compiler is generated by

    tools/jit_matrix/gen_asmjit_sources.py

and deliberately excludes `ujit/` (the unified compiler is experimental and
DeSmuME does not use it). The headers are kept so that a future experiment
does not have to re-import the tree.

The previous bundled copy lives at `src/utils/AsmJit` (1.0.x). It is kept
read-only during the migration so that the two generations can be compared,
but it must not be compiled at the same time.
